name: AI Stealth Gateway
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y xvfb libgl1 libglx-mesa0 libosmesa6 libgbm-dev libnss3 libasound2 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libgtk-3-0 && npm install && sudo npm install -g pm2 && mkdir -p ~/.vscode-server/data/Machine ~/.vscode-remote/data/Machine && echo '{"security.workspace.trust.enabled":false, "security.workspace.trust.startupPrompt":"never"}' > ~/.vscode-server/data/Machine/settings.json && echo '{"security.workspace.trust.enabled":false, "security.workspace.trust.startupPrompt":"never"}' > ~/.vscode-remote/data/Machine/settings.json
postStartCommand: pm2 delete all || true && pm2 start npm --name 'ai-gateway' -- run start
